intent: 萤火虫：暖黄绿色的光点在黑暗中缓慢漂浮，忽明忽暗地闪烁
pass_criteria: sparse warm yellow-green glow points on near-black
brightness variation across the population (some dim, some bright = blink feel)
soft glow halos, not hard dots

params: Box emitter distributes fireflies across a broad atmospheric field
Open the individual XYZ emitter-size controls before setting field dimensions
Spread births beyond the comp width so edges remain naturally populated
Fill the full comp height rather than creating a horizontal strip
Give the swarm depth variation for organic scale and brightness differences
Keep the population sparse and readable as individual fireflies
Very low initial speed prevents rain-like directional travel
Uniform emission removes any single travel direction
Allow movement to disperse in every direction
Long enough life for slow floating motion without becoming a dense cloud
No gravity so particles do not read as falling snow or rising embers
Enable air resistance so wind and turbulence can create gentle wandering
Turbulence bends each particle into slow independent wandering paths
Large turbulence features create broad drifting curves rather than jitter
Keep motion simple and calm instead of chaotic
Small point-sized bodies preserve the firefly look
Vary particle scale so the field has near and far specimens
Leave enough core brightness for the glow to bloom
Strong per-particle opacity variation creates a natural blink population
Set Color to At Birth so the warm yellow-green color is used
Use Glow Sphere particles for soft luminous points
Additive blending makes overlapping lights feel emissive
Create a substantial soft halo around each light
Keep halos visible but avoid turning the sparse field into fog
Enable modest motion blur for the occasional moving light
Natural shutter value without streaking the dots
expressions: The emitter slowly breathes around the frame center, preventing a static-looking field

params: Add restrained HDR bloom to the brightest fireflies
Keep glow halos soft and local rather than washing the black background
Favor the brighter blinking lights while letting dim fireflies remain subtle
Feather the glow threshold for smooth brightness transitions
Retain the crisp luminous cores beneath the bloom

prior_iterations.critique: The visual treatment is strong: the near-black field, warm yellow-green color, varied intensities, and soft diffuse halos all read as fireflies rather than hard particle dots. However, population density is inconsistent across the sampled times: t1 has only about six isolated lights, while t4 contains roughly thirty lights and begins to feel like a populated particle field rather than a sparse firefly scene. The sampled frames do not clearly demonstrate slow wandering because the much larger number of newly visible particles dominates the temporal change.

The near-black background, yellow-green emissive color, and soft local halos are visually on target. At t4 the field is sparse and has a convincing mix of dimmer and brighter fireflies, with no rain- or snow-like directionality. However, the population remains temporally inconsistent: t1 contains only two visible lights and feels nearly empty, while t4 has roughly ten. This reads more as particles accumulating after emission begins than a continuously inhabited firefly field. The two sampled stills also do not yet make the intended slow wandering motion clearly legible.
